title: The Spotlight block kit sits beside the one block registry
detail:
Split from PROG-E2 on 2026-11-16, the second of the folds (after PROG-E2B). The Spotlight block kit (lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts) is moved to lib/entity-blocks/spotlight.ts. Every one of its nine types (heading, text, links, image, gallery, quote, stats, embed, divider) was already an ENTITY_BLOCKS row a member may hold; the file now keeps only what the registry does not: the stored shape of each block and the validator's limits. Every importer is re-pointed. The block-system ratchet is lowered 4 to 3 through the gate's own --update path.

Owner approval (Daniel, 2026-11-16 16:50Z, "Approve all of them"): re-point scripts/probes/member-joined-year.mjs (SCAN-1042), SCAN-1182's source.file, scripts/probes/no-top-friends-code.mjs, and the import line in four tests (lib/spotlight/blocks/validate.test.ts, lib/spotlight/puck/convert.test.ts, lib/entity-blocks/member-adapter.test.ts, components/page-editor/blocks/linktree.test.ts) to lib/entity-blocks/spotlight.ts. Those six only, each asserting what it asserted before.

VERIFIED: goldens (lib/entity-blocks/spotlight.golden.test.tsx) written and green against the old file first, then green after the move with only the first import changed. They freeze every limit, the validated layout of a stored layout holding all nine types, and the rendered markup of each type, and they hold each type to a registry row a member may hold. The re-pointed probes and tests pass. Rebuilt 2026-11-16 after the first build was lost with its session; same scope.

NOT VERIFIED: no browser pass on a live Spotlight, no Vercel build. Said plainly, what is NOT unified: the renderer (components/spotlight/blocks/render.tsx) and the validator (lib/spotlight/blocks/validate.ts) still switch on the nine types themselves.

verify.note: Fails on the prior tree: lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts exists, sixteen files import it, there are no goldens, and block-systems reads 4. Passes when the old file is gone and unimported, every type in the kit's BlockType union is an ENTITY_BLOCKS row a member may hold (loaded from the real registry), the goldens are in the tree, and the ratchet reads 3 or lower.
